## Quality gate

This is a stylized custom / cartoon interpretation. It **does not meet** the Helvetia AAA photorealistic car standard. Do not claim it is 1:1 accurate, fully collision-ready, vehicle-rigged or fitted with a detailed engine.

For UE5: the source uses the `EXT_meshopt_compression` glTF extension, which may require a supporting importer or decompression before importing; run an import test before adding it to the game. Continue searching for an independently authored photorealistic Macan.

## Rights gate

The CC BY author listing permits commercial use and sharing of the *mesh* subject to attribution, provided the uploader is the genuine author. Independently review Porsche vehicle design and logo/trademark rights before commercial release. No redistributed NFS/CSR/Forza/Racing Master ripped meshes permitted.
